annotations.exact_quote: The recently proposed low-rank representation (LRR) method has been empirically shown to be useful in various tasks such as motion segmentation, image segmentation, saliency detection and face recognition.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文以低秩表示（LRR）方法为核心研究对象，并对其成功条件进行理论分析；引用句明确LRR为低秩表示方法，满足显式低秩表示/建模。
